Homrich & Berg decreased its stake in Altria Group Inc (MO) by 30.28% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Homrich & Berg sold 29,056 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.98% with the market. The institutional investor held 66,889 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.17 million, down from 95,945 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Homrich & Berg who had been investing in Altria Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $109.33 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.78% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $57.71. About 6.82M shares traded. Altria Group, Inc. (NYSE:MO) has declined 24.97% since June 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 37.54% the S&P500.
